rule: Each box has a corner with two thick short marks touching the two edges that meet at that corner, placed symmetrically about the corner diagonal (same distance from the corner on each edge). Figures 1, 2, 3 and 5 follow this; figure 4 breaks the symmetry.
options_check: 1: BL corner, two parallel slashes touching left and bottom edges about 55px from corner each, symmetric, fits. 2: TL corner, two backslashes touching left and top edges, roughly symmetric, fits. 3: TR corner, vertical mark touches top edge and diagonal mark touches right edge, both within ~10px of corner, symmetric, fits. 4: TR corner, vertical mark ~5px from corner on top edge but diagonal touches right edge ~40px below the corner, asymmetric, odd. 5: BR corner, two backslashes touching right and bottom edges ~30px from corner each, symmetric, fits (but marks are collinear, a possible alternative reading where 5 is odd).
redraw_diffs: Redraw boxes are square while the originals are wider than tall; stroke widths and exact mark offsets differ slightly. Mark types, corners, and the fig3 vs fig4 diagonal position difference are preserved, so the answer should not change.
